fact: On 11 May 2026 the Salamat province launched training of operational staff on the budget-execution module of SIGFiP and on the E-Tax and standardised e-invoicing (FEN) platforms, under the 2025 and 2026 finance laws.
title: Tchad : au Salamat, lancement de la formation sur le SIGFiP, E-Tax et la Facture Électronique Normalisée
